burst: Affects the same target when at Max HP.
Deals 1440% of final ATK as additional damage.

caveats: ⚑ skill2 has NO activation clause in the kit text — the interval trigger and its 10s period are an INVENTED cadence (interval convention for clause-free damage lines). Total skill2 contribution scales 1:1 with this guess (180s / sec procs); pin it from a datamined skill cooldown or a focus recording before trusting any skill-bucket number.

⚑ Base weapon cadence (pulls/s from rate_of_fire) and reloadFrames=99 are datamine-unreliable fields; they set how fast the skill1 hitCount:30 window re-arms (AR hitsPerShot 1 ⇒ 30 rounds ≈ half a 60-round magazine), so buff UPTIME rides on them.

The burst's second 1440% branch is gated on the enemy being at Max HP. There is no target-HP model in v1 and no schema gate for it; at scope lock the boss is below Max HP from the opening shots, so every burst after t=0 fails the condition — the branch is recorded unmodeled rather than credited unconditionally. If a real fight ever shows the doubled burst popup (a first burst landing on an undamaged boss), this needs a target-HP gate primitive.
Both damage lines target 'the enemy with the highest final DEF'; the scope-lock fight has a single partless boss, so that selection is trivially the boss — modeled as target 'enemy'.

Both damage lines are function damage: crit at the caster's sheet rate, no core (the text never says 'core strike damage'), no +30% range (engine force-set). noFb is left unset (default FB-by-timing ON) for the skill2 rider; the burst cast is engine-exempt from the +50% Full Burst major because it resolves before the FB window opens.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. brid — AR/Water/Attacker/Burst III, ammo 60, hitsPerShot 1, cd 40s, no charge. S1 is a self ATK ▲18.52% for 10s re-armed every 30 rounds fired (~half a magazine), so uptime is high but not permanent and depends on the ⚑ cadence tuple. S2 is a single-target 211.2%-of-final-ATK function hit with no activation clause in the kit — modeled as an interval proc at a ⚑ estimated 10s period. Burst is a 1440%-of-final-ATK single-target hit on the owner's own burst cast. The burst's second 1440% branch (enemy at Max HP) is deliberately unmodeled: v1 has no target-HP model, and at scope lock the boss is already damaged before the first burst, so crediting it would over-count every rotation.
